illustrator_ai.role: straight-on panel geometry; red circles are construction/control markers, not material

reference_photo.role: straight-on physical knob material and pointer reference

reference_measurements_px.photo_component_detection: dark connected components in front.jpg at luminance < 70; cap/pointer widths measured from center-row white runs

major_density_time_pitch.pointer: white trapezoid/slot, approximately 14 px wide at this scale, extending from cap to outer edge
major_density_time_pitch.body: black segmented annulus with recessed grooves and soft gray highlights; no continuous brass outline

medium_size_shape.pointer: white broad slot/wedge, visibly wider than a hairline

small_panel_knobs.appearance: black body, white pointer slot, highlight/shadow; no brass ring

grainfield_measurements_px.outer_shadow_bbox: same connected silhouette as visible non-panel region

differences.finding: Reference pointer is a broad white trapezoid/slot reaching through the black ring; Grainfield is a 6 px tan hairline. At capture scale the Grainfield pointer is about 40% of the reference relative width (3.6% vs approximately 9%).
differences.action: Replace with a value-rotated broad slot/wedge after rights-safe visual calibration. Keep exact angle/value mapping under test.

differences.finding: Reference uses a black, physically segmented annulus with recessed radial grooves and gray highlight/shadow. Grainfield uses a continuous brass/gold outline around a flat cap.
differences.action: Model a procedural black annulus with repeated recessed segments and subtle highlight; remove the continuous brass outline unless a future licensed reference supports it.

differences.finding: Reference has a bright off-white inner cap occupying roughly 53% to 61% of the outer diameter. Grainfield has no inner cap and remains dark across the disc.
differences.action: Add an inset off-white cap and preserve black annulus depth/shading.

differences.finding: The generated capture silhouette is 167x169 px while the reference major knob component is 155x152 px and medium component 119x117 px. Absolute comparison is scale-dependent; the DXF-derived physical diameter remains authoritative for placement.
differences.action: Validate per-skin diameter in a full panel render at the normalized AI/DXF scale; do not change control-map radii from this photo-only comparison.

differences.finding: Current centers inherit the validated DXF-to-AI mapping (mean residual 1.0113 pt, maximum 1.0765 pt). The isolated knob captures do not include the panel, so knob-to-label and knob-to-marker alignment cannot be pixel-verified here.
differences.action: Capture a rights-cleared or local authoring full-panel overlay before release; retain current control-map provenance.

decision: No implementation change made: current procedural skin is materially unlike the straight-on reference and requires deliberate visual calibration; changing it from this read-only audit would be speculative.
